definitions.explanation: An informal, somewhat masculine word for breakfast. Less polite than {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}.

examples.japanese: {朝飯|あさめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧。
{朝飯|あさめし}{前|まえ}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.notes: Literally "before breakfast" — an expression meaning something is very easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{朝飯|あさめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy today that I didn't have time to eat breakfast.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal word for breakfast, typically used by men or in casual settings. ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧ is the standard neutral term. Often heard in the set expression {朝飯|あさめし}{前|まえ} (literally "before breakfast"), meaning something is extremely easy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝飯|あさめし}{前|まえ} (a piece of cake; very easy)
- {朝飯|あさめし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ (to eat breakfast — informal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧: breakfast — standard, neutral
- ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧: breakfast — formal
- ⟦{昼飯|ひるめし}→昼飯：17357_hirumeshi⟧: lunch — same informal register
